en.headline: sogeisetsu: 311 commits, 25 PRs and 47 issues across 16 repos in 30 days
en.teaser: A month of skill releases, docs tooling and upstream OpenCode bug reports, led by 17 releases in asset-inventory and 4 in meld-deepresearch.
en.overview:
Across 2026-09-17 to 2026-10-16 the account recorded 311 commits, 25 pull requests and 47 issues, with no reviews and no missing days. Most of the commit volume sits in three repositories: `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` and `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, while the issue volume is concentrated in `openchamber/openchamber` and `anomalyco/opencode`.

`asset-inventory` was the busiest project: it moved through a long run of releases from v1.3.0 to v1.15.0, adding an English-first documentation restructure, seven fixed-string languages, a Material docs site with rendered bilingual samples, a PR-triggered docs check with version and glossary consistency rules, a registry-first host-command scan, and skills.sh installation. Several correctness fixes landed as well, including MCP enumeration that had silently dropped servers, a broken `update.ps1`, skill provenance and agent model chains, and a new broken state marker for registered-but-uninvokable assets.

`meld-deepresearch` produced four releases. v0.1.0 opened the series; v0.2.0 wrote down rules for inaccessible sources and improved validator messages; v0.3.0 split the work into three cooperating skills with hard delivery gates; v0.4.0 added a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping the gate scripts, plus a bilingual landing page and observation evidence type. `opencode-go-model-picker` reached v1.0.0 and v1.3.0 with plan-aware allocation, discovery and snapshot-summary scripts, offline price seeds and clearer failure-mode documentation.

The remaining work was smaller but concrete: the profile repository added a 30-day activity card with a daily workflow, English copy and neutral wording fixes; `opencode-agent-sandbox` set up AGENTS.md and a knowledge base for OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture and Windows path findings; `myBlog` added three OpenChamber capture samples; and `opencode-skill-creator` only received automated commits. Upstream, reports were filed on OpenChamber multi-run processes, context panel math, browser capture scaling and issue unlinking, and on OpenCode Go image handling, Windows CLI access and websearch provider failures. Earlier dates in the window were reconstructed through GitHub search, so issue and discussion counts are approximate and release coverage is limited to the account's own repositories.

highlights.text: v1.7.0 merged: seven languages, a Material docs site and rendered examples.
Registry-first host-command scan so inventories stop losing commands.
Three cooperating skills, a clean reading copy and three hard gates.
First stable release with plan-aware allocation and fallback chains.
Multi-run deletion leaves orphaned MCP child processes and blocks worktree removal.
Go endpoint rejects every image for models that advertise image input.
Skill submission for sogeisetsu/asset-inventory opened for listing.
Eval robustness hardened across parsing, aggregation and install.

byRepo.text: 139 own commits, 16 PRs and 17 releases, with no automated commits. The month was dominated by release work: English-first restructure with a paired Chinese doc set, seven fixed-string languages incl. a Japanese glossary block, a Material docs site with rendered bilingual samples, a PR-triggered docs check with version and glossary validation, a release-prep script, security guards for discovery evidence, a **broken** state marker for registered-but-uninvokable assets, registry-first host-command scanning and skills.sh installation. Fixes covered silently dropped MCP servers, `update.ps1` nested directories, skill provenance and agent model chains, and merge scope between same-named commands and skills.

76 own commits and 4 releases, no automated commits. The skill grew from v0.1.0 to v0.4.0: rules for blocked or paywalled sources, validator messages that explain how to fix a failure, splitting into three cooperating skills with hard delivery gates, a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping all six gate scripts, a first-class observations evidence type with C1-C8 fixes, a bilingual landing page with light and dark themes, a Chinese README with a language switch, and M1 validation scripts, examples and CI.

66 own commits plus 241 automated commits, no PRs, issues or releases. Work centred on the profile itself: a 30-day activity card with a daily update workflow, later changed to rolling updates every two hours with a more detailed summary, plus fixes so statistics and splits can no longer disagree. Copy was switched to English and made neutral across the card and README, and CI was upgraded to checkout/setup-node v7 to drop the deprecated Node 20 runtime, with manual date input added to the workflow.

28 issues and no own commits, PRs or releases. Reports and follow-ups covered orphaned MCP child processes after multi-run deletion that then block git worktree removal, a context panel breakdown that divides whole-session estimates by the last message's input so the remainder is always zero, browser captures exported at 1x on high-DPI displays, the inability to unlink an agent-linked issue or PR, a skipped-role notice merging two replies into one turn, thinking level not following a model switch, a Go quota shown as provider not configured, stale AGENTS.md saves, multi-run docs and tests referencing a removed sidebar button, and shared command palette icons.

19 own commits and 3 releases, no automated commits. v1.0.0 shipped plan-aware allocation with a two-question first-run diagnostic and fallback chains; v1.1.0 reworked the output into a scannable three-part body plus data appendix; v1.3.0 rolled up discovery and chain-safety tooling with `discover-agents.mjs` and `snapshot-summary.mjs`. Also added an offline price seed, visible checkpoint markers, clarified failure-mode status semantics, preserved snapshot preferences on refresh, aligned the schema version and documented source repository provenance.

8 PRs and 4 issues, with no own commits, automated commits or releases. The four opened PRs were all closed with fixes: disposing review servers on plugin unload, accepting CRLF line endings in skill frontmatter validation, opening the review URL with a platform-specific browser command, and hardening eval robustness in parsing, aggregation and install. Issues covered OpenCode V2 compatibility where the plugin fails to load with a V1 plugin API error, and dist rebuilds inlining @opencode-ai/plugin and zod and swamping small PR diffs.

8 own commits, no automated commits, PRs, issues or releases. The repository was started from an initial commit and given an AGENTS.md plus a knowledge base directory, including Excalidraw sketches. Knowledge entries archived findings on OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication and Windows path pitfalls, and on oh-my-opencode-slim together with hosted OpenCode experiments. The knowledge section was generalised beyond Git and GitHub, and adding knowledge was made the default action in AGENTS.md.

7 issues, no own commits, PRs or releases. Reports filed covered Go models that advertise image input while the Go endpoint rejects every image with a 400, a stale image read after five or more images in one session, a Windows desktop that ships the CLI with no way to run it, worktree removal blocked by cached locations, and a tinyfish websearch provider returning HTTP 400 on every search. The auth.json removal behaviour and several of these reports were followed up, and the websearch and image-input reports were later closed.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu：30 天内 16 个仓库 311 次提交、25 个 PR、47 个 issue
zh.teaser: 这一个月以技能发布、文档工具链和上游 OpenCode 问题报告为主，asset-inventory 发布 17 个版本，meld-deepresearch 发布 4 个版本。
zh.overview:
2026-09-17 至 2026-10-16 期间，账号共记录 311 次提交、25 个拉取请求和 47 个 issue，没有代码评审，也没有缺失数据的日期。提交量主要集中在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`、`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 和 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 三个仓库，而 issue 主要集中在 `openchamber/openchamber` 和 `anomalyco/opencode`。

`asset-inventory` 是最繁忙的项目：版本从 v1.3.0 一路推进到 v1.15.0，期间完成英文优先的文档重构、七种固定字符串语言、带渲染双语示例的 Material 文档站、由 PR 触发的文档检查与版本、术语表一致性校验、release-prep 脚本、发现过程的安全防护、面向已注册但无法调用资产的 broken 状态标记、注册表优先的宿主命令扫描以及 skills.sh 安装方式。修复方面覆盖了被静默漏掉的 MCP 服务器、`update.ps1` 的嵌套目录问题、技能来源与代理模型链、以及同名命令与技能之间的合并范围。

`meld-deepresearch` 发布了四个版本：v0.1.0 起步，v0.2.0 为无法访问的来源写定规则并改进校验器提示，v0.3.0 拆分为三个协作技能并设置硬性交付门禁，v0.4.0 增加包裹全部门禁脚本的 `meld.py` 命令行、双语落地页和 observations 证据类型。`opencode-go-model-picker` 达到 v1.0.0 与 v1.3.0，包含按套餐分配、发现与快照摘要脚本、离线价格种子以及更清晰失败模式文档。

其余工作规模较小但内容具体：个人主页仓库加入 30 天活动卡片与每日工作流，并把文案统一为中性英文；`opencode-agent-sandbox` 建立 AGENTS.md 与知识库，记录 OpenCode V2 分发、架构与 Windows 路径经验；`myBlog` 加入三张 OpenChamber 截图样本；`opencode-skill-creator` 只收到自动提交。上游方面提交了关于 OpenChamber 多运行进程残留、上下文面板计算、浏览器截图分辨率与取消关联的问题，以及 OpenCode Go 图片输入、Windows 命令行入口和 websearch 提供商失败的问题。窗口较早的日期通过 GitHub 搜索重建，因此 issue 与讨论数量为近似值，版本信息仅覆盖本人仓库。

highlights.text: v1.7.0 合并：七种语言、Material 文档站与渲染示例。
改为注册表优先的宿主命令扫描，避免清单遗漏命令。
三个协作技能、干净阅读副本与三道硬性门禁。
首个稳定版本，提供按套餐分配与回退链。
删除多运行后残留 MCP 子进程，并导致工作树无法移除。
声明支持图片输入的模型在 Go 端点上传图片一律返回 400。
为 sogeisetsu/asset-inventory 提交收录技能列表的 PR。
加固解析、聚合与安装环节的评测稳健性。

byRepo.text: 139 次本人提交、16 个 PR、17 个版本，无自动提交。这一个月以发布为主线：英文优先重构并配套中文文档集、七种固定字符串语言（含日语术语表）、带渲染双语示例的 Material 文档站、由 PR 触发的文档检查与版本和术语表校验、release-prep 脚本、发现过程安全防护、为已注册但无法调用的资产新增 **broken** 状态标记、注册表优先的宿主命令扫描以及 skills.sh 安装。修复覆盖被静默漏掉的 MCP 服务器、`update.ps1` 嵌套目录、技能来源与代理模型链，以及同名命令与技能之间的合并范围。
76 次本人提交、4 个版本，无自动提交。技能从 v0.1.0 演进到 v0.4.0：为被墙或付费墙阻隔的来源写定规则，校验器提示如何修复失败，拆分为三个协作技能并设置硬性交付门禁，增加包裹全部六个门禁脚本的 `meld.py` 命令行，加入 observations 证据类型与 C1-C8 修复，双语落地页支持明暗主题，中文 README 带语言切换，以及 M1 校验脚本、示例与 CI。
66 次本人提交，另有 241 次自动提交，没有 PR、issue 或版本。工作围绕个人主页展开：加入 30 天活动卡片与每日更新工作流，随后改为每两小时滚动更新并让摘要更详细，同时修复统计数字与拆分不一致的问题。卡片与 README 的文案统一为中性英文，CI 升级到 checkout/setup-node v7 以摆脱已弃用的 Node 20 运行时，工作流还支持手动指定日期。

28 个 issue，没有本人提交、PR 或版本。报告与跟进包括：删除多运行后残留 MCP 子进程并导致 git 工作树移除失败、上下文面板把整段会话估算除以最后一条消息输入使剩余项始终为零、200% 缩放下浏览器截图按 1 倍像素导出、无法在界面上取消代理关联的 issue 或 PR、跳过角色提示把两条回复合并为一个回合、切换模型后思考等级未跟随模型默认值、Go 配额显示为未配置提供商、AGENTS.md 外部修改后被旧数据覆盖、多运行文档与测试仍指向已移除的侧边栏按钮，以及命令面板与侧边栏共用图标。

19 次本人提交、3 个版本，无自动提交。v1.0.0 提供按套餐分配、两题首次诊断与回退链；v1.1.0 把输出重构为可扫读的三段正文加数据附录；v1.3.0 汇总发现与链安全工具，加入 `discover-agents.mjs` 与 `snapshot-summary.mjs`。此外加入离线价格种子、可见检查点标记，澄清失败模式状态语义，刷新时保留快照偏好，对齐 schema 版本，并在 SKILL.md 中注明来源仓库。

8 个 PR、4 个 issue，没有本人提交、自动提交或版本。四个已开启的 PR 均以修复关闭：插件卸载时释放评审服务器、技能 frontmatter 校验接受 CRLF 行尾、用平台相关浏览器命令打开评审链接、加固解析聚合与安装环节的评测稳健性。issue 涉及 OpenCode V2 兼容性（插件因 V1 插件 API 报 PluginModule.LoadError 无法加载）以及 dist 重新构建内联 @opencode-ai/plugin 与 zod、淹没小 PR 差异的问题。

8 次本人提交，无自动提交、PR、issue 或版本。仓库从初始提交开始，加入 AGENTS.md 与知识库目录，并附 Excalidraw 草图。知识条目归档了 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构、认证与 Windows 路径坑，以及 oh-my-opencode-slim 与托管 OpenCode 的实测经验。知识范围从 Git 与 GitHub 泛化为各类知识，AGENTS.md 也把补充知识设为默认动作。
7 个 issue，没有本人提交、PR 或版本。报告包括：声明支持图片输入的 Go 模型在 Go 端点上传图片一律返回 400、同一会话五张以上图片后读到过期图片、Windows 桌面版自带命令行却没有入口、缓存位置阻塞工作树移除、tinyfish 搜索提供商每次搜索返回 HTTP 400。删除 auth.json 后的行为等问题也有跟进，websearch 与图片输入相关报告随后被关闭。
